title: p Tag
content:
The `

` tag in HTML defines a paragraph. Browsers automatically add a single blank line before and after each paragraph, creating a clear separation between blocks of text. It's a block-level element, meaning it occupies the full width available to it and starts on a new line. Visit the following resources to learn more: - [@video@HTML - Paragraphs | W3Schools](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qis4kAOThLw)
